blocks.text: Water is the foundation of life. It keeps humans alive and healthy through hydration and hygiene, and removes toxic materials from the body. It allows plants to perform photosynthesis and supports agriculture by enabling crop growth. Animals rely on it to regulate body functions, and countless microorganisms depend on it for survival. Human development, agriculture, and food security all revolve around a steady supply of water. In nature, water shapes the land, maintains a balance in the climate, and recharges underground reservoirs. Ecosystems like rivers, lakes, wetlands, and oceans rely on water to support diverse plant and animal life. It is vital for energy production, transportation, urban development, and scientific research. Water scarcity threatens the environment, communities, and economies.
